  • a news article to summarize its main idea. It serves to attract readers while
  • giving them a clear idea of what the story is about. A good headline is accurate,
  • concise, engaging, written in active voice, and often uses present tense to create
  • a sense of immediacy. [K] / [CO1, CO2]

questions.solution_html:
• Feature stories are in-depth articles that focus on human interest,
  • background information, or narrative storytelling, often exploring a topic with
  • more detail and creativity. Unlike hard news, which prioritizes timely, factual
  • reporting on current events, feature stories are less time-sensitive and allow for
  • a more descriptive and emotional tone. They aim to inform, entertain, or inspire
  • rather than simply report immediate facts.

  • the organization. Therefore, it shapes the identity of the media.

  • doesn't require giving equal weight to misinformation or harmful ideologies.
  • Recent controversies, such as the coverage of climate change denial or extremist
  • political rhetoric, highlight how some media outlets have confused balance with
  • false equivalence. Responsible editorial judgment involves filtering out baseless
  • claims while still ensuring fair representation of legitimate, fact-based
  • viewpoints. [K] / [CO2, CO3,CO4]

questions.question: Compare the layout of a traditional broadsheet newspaper and a tabloid. / [CO1, CO2]
questions.solution_html:

  • more formal, structured design, often featuring multiple columns, dense text,
  • and a clear separation between news sections. It typically uses smaller font sizes
  • and focuses on in-depth coverage of national and international issues, with less
  • emphasis on visual elements. In contrast, a tabloid is smaller and more compact,
  • with larger images, bold headlines, and a more sensationalized approach to
  • stories, often focusing on celebrity, entertainment, and scandal. The design of a
  • tabloid is more visually dynamic, with a greater emphasis on grabbing attention
  • through striking layouts and engaging visuals. [U] / [CO1, CO2)
